chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: 'In every month is an Umra'.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah (title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about performing Umra every month?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi (Chapter 206) highlights the exclusive virtue of Umra by reporting that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) performed it monthly, distinguishing it from the obligatory Hajj. In Shia scholarly tradition, this practice underscores the concept of continuous spiritual purification and the high status of the Minor Pilgrimage as a means of drawing closer to Allah throughout the year.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘In every month is an Umra’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya’qub who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ’Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would say, ’Every month there should be only one al-‘Umrah.’”
